company.name: GreenTally
company.shortDescription: GreenTally provides AI-powered carbon accounting software and ESG services for business emissions tracking and reporting.
company.description: GreenTally provides an AI-powered carbon accounting platform combined with ESG advisory services for businesses. The software automates emissions calculations across scopes 1, 2, and 3 using verified emission factors and large language models, turning activity and spend data into audit-ready carbon footprints. It offers supply chain overviews, emissions tracking, water usage insights, category analysis, and interactive dashboards to support ongoing monitoring. GreenTally’s team delivers emissions measurement services, reduction strategies, and ESG reports aligned with leading standards and regulatory frameworks. The platform is designed for organisations of various sizes, from small businesses to larger enterprises, that need to meet compliance requirements and manage sustainability data in a structured way.
